title: Identification of novel T-cell epitopes on monkeypox virus and development of multi-epitopes vaccine using immunoinformatics approaches.
authors: Ezzemani, Wahiba; Ouladlahsen, Ahd; Altawalah, Haya; Saile, Rachid; Sarih, M'hammed; Kettani, Anass; Ezzikouri, Sayeh
one_liner_zh: 该文用免疫信息学设计猴痘病毒多表位疫苗，涉及蛋白-受体对接与MD模拟，但对象为蛋白-蛋白（疫苗-TLR9）互作，非蛋白质-DNA体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Monkeypox virus (MPV) is closely related to the smallpox virus, and previous data from Africa suggest that the smallpox vaccine (VARV) is at least 85% effective in preventing MPV. No multi-epitope vaccine has yet been developed to prevent MPV infection. In this work, we used in silico structural biology and advanced immunoinformatic strategies to design a multi-epitope subunit vaccine against MPV infection. The designed vaccine sequence is adjuvanted with CpG-ODN and includes HTL/CTL epitopes for similar proteins between vaccinia virus (VACV) that induced T-cell production in vaccinated volunteers and the first draft sequence of the MPV genome associated with the suspected outbreak in several countries, May 2022. In addition, the specific binding of the modified vaccine and the immune Toll-like receptor 9 (TLR9) was estimated by molecular interaction studies. Strong interaction in the binding groove as well as good docking scores confirmed the stringency of the modified vaccine. The stability of the interaction was confirmed by a classical molecular dynamics simulation and normal mode analysis. Then, the immune simulation also indicated the ability of this vaccine to induce an effective immune response against MPV. Codon optimization and in silico cloning of the vaccine into the pET-28a (+) vector also showed its expression potential in the E. coli K12 system. The promising data obtained from the various in silico studies indicate that this vaccine is effective against MPV. However, additional in vitro and in vivo studies are still needed to confirm its efficacy.Communicated by Ramaswamy H. Sarma.
abstract_zh: 猴痘病毒（MPV）与天花病毒密切相关，此前来自非洲的数据表明，天花疫苗（VARV）在预防MPV方面至少具有85%的有效性。目前尚未开发出预防MPV感染的多表位疫苗。在本研究中，我们利用计算机结构生物学和先进的免疫信息学策略，设计了一种针对MPV感染的多表位亚单位疫苗。所设计的疫苗序列以CpG-ODN为佐剂，并包含针对痘苗病毒（VACV）与2022年5月多个国家疑似暴发相关的MPV基因组首版草图中相似蛋白的HTL/CTL表位，这些表位在接种疫苗的志愿者中诱导了T细胞产生。此外，通过分子相互作用研究评估了修饰后疫苗与免疫Toll样受体9（TLR9）的特异性结合。结合槽中的强相互作用以及良好的对接分数证实了修饰后疫苗的严谨性。通过经典分子动力学模拟和简正模式分析确认了相互作用的稳定性。随后，免疫模拟也表明该疫苗具有诱导针对MPV有效免疫反应的能力。密码子优化及将疫苗克隆至pET-28a(+)载体中的计算机模拟也显示了其在E. coli K12系统中的表达潜力。各项计算机研究获得的令人鼓舞的数据表明，该疫苗对MPV具有有效性。然而，仍需进一步的体外和体内研究以确认其效力。由Ramaswamy H. Sarma通讯。
